name: Myositis Ossificans
definition: Localized heterotopic bone formation within muscle, usually after trauma or contusion, often evolving from painful swelling to a mature ossified mass.

typical: Painful enlarging muscle mass after trauma

investigations.principle: Serial radiographs/CT show peripheral maturation; MRI can mimic sarcoma early and requires timing/context correlation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Avoid repeated traumatic massage in acute phase
amber: Biopsy/excision should be delayed or specialist-planned if diagnosis is uncertain because early lesions may mimic malignancy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Asthi post-traumatic phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Localized heterotopic bone formation within muscle, usually after trauma or contusion, often evolving from painful swelling to a mature ossified mass.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
